FRAME – / 8 HOLD 2.5S

Slow carousel, no FPS race

The badge collects eight independently checked frames in any order. Duplicates are ignored, and a missed frame is picked up on the next pass.

  1. Press the badge's left button and keep the camera aimed here.
  2. Start the carousel. Each QR remains still for 2.5 seconds.
  3. After all eight frames, preview the wallpaper and choose Keep or Discard.
